ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the lateral lobes, bisected by a dark vertical median column. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the fluke insertion point, forming a large irregular blob on the inner-left lobe and smaller speckled mottling on the inner-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and jagged towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on the distal halves of both lobes, transitioning to a concave sweep as the edges converge towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular and rosette-shaped clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered across the central dark-pigment column, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) visible on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe's mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-relief, high-contrast clusters along the trailing edges and tips consistent with dense ectoparasitic/barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, large-scale irregular dark pigment patch on the left lobe's interior-lower quadrant.
